rules.name: ordinary-chat-real-github-task
rules.when: ordinary chat needs a real dependency-aware repository task to execute without requiring Work, Codex, or an online local device

rules.name: ordinary-chat-infrastructure-self-test
rules.when: the user explicitly asks to validate the ordinary-chat execution infrastructure itself

rules.name: provider-native-first
rules.when: a connected native app directly supports the provider and requested action

rules.name: deterministic-local-first
rules.when: the task is deterministic, bounded, local, and does not need an autonomous loop

rules.name: long-local-task
rules.when: the task requires repeated inspect-act-verify cycles or multi-file repair

rules.name: governed-multi-step-repair
rules.when: the task benefits from dependency-aware multi-role execution and receipt adjudication

rules.name: browser-deterministic
rules.when: browser work is scripted/replayable and persistent interactive state is not required

rules.name: browser-adaptive
rules.when: browser work needs an agentic multi-step loop that adapts to changing page state but does not specifically require MCP introspection

rules.name: browser-stateful
rules.when: browser work needs persistent session state, accessibility-tree introspection, extension attachment, or exploratory interaction

rules.name: project-memory-read
rules.when: the task needs explicit project recall or provenance search for a workspace

rules.name: local-observability
rules.when: the user needs visual preflight, run status, receipt inspection, or capability health without mutation

rules.name: mcp-gateway
rules.when: the host exposes custom MCP and the request is capability discovery, health, adaptive routing, preflight, liveness, run status, receipt retrieval, project-memory search, or a guarded mutation supported by the bridge
